test_title: PYST 8: SSC CPO - Quantitative Aptitude (Held On 12 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question:
A job can be done by 18 women in 10 days. After working for 4 days, 6 women leave.

How many more days will the remaining women take to finish the job?
solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Total Work Units = 18 women × 10 days = 180 units

Work completed in 4 days = 18 women × 4 days = 72 units

Remaining Work = 180 − 72 = 108 units

Remaining Women = 18 − 6 = 12 women

Days for remaining women = 108 units ÷ 12 women = 9 days

**∴ Answer = 9**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Initial number of women (M₁) = 18

Total time (Dₜₒₜₐₗ) = 10 days

Time worked (Dwₒᵣₖₑd) = 4 days

Number of women who left = 6

**Formula used:**

Total Work = M₁ × D₁ | Remaining Work = M₂ × D₂

 
 
• 
 
 Total Job (10 Days by 18 Women)
 
 
 4 Days Done
 18 Women
 
 Remaining Work
 12 Women (18 − 6)
 
 

 Required: 9 Days
 
 
 
 

 
 

**Calculations:**

Total work to be done = 18 × 10 = 180 units

⇒ Work done in 4 days = 18 × 4 = 72 units

⇒ Remaining work = 180 − 72 = 108 units

⇒ Remaining women = 18 − 6 = 12 women

⇒ Time taken by remaining women = 108 ÷ 12

⇒ Time taken = 9 days

**∴ The correct answer is 9.**</p
